issues.on_page: Sales to customers 2,912,812 (Enterprise Funds Total: Water + Sewer)
issues.issue: Water/sewer sales to customers fit the user's Utility Charges receipt category (2026-10-28). user_rules.py won't catch this because receipt lines have no fund name and the label doesn't match its patterns. Tap fees 24,403 (receipts[12]) are similar.
A combined salaries-and-benefits line. Every governmental detail line with the same label uses salaries and wages, so Salaries and Wages would be consistent.

Department fee lines keep category charges for services, but their detail_category points to the user's own receipt categories: Cemetery -> Cemetery Fees, Ambulance 635,537 (detail[25]) -> Ambulance Fees, Airport 181,490 (detail[31]) -> Rentals, Recreation Center/Pool/Park fees and admissions (detail[37], [43], [44], [50]) -> Recreation Fees. user_rules.py matches labels only ('Rental and fees') and won't move them.

issues.on_page: Rural Fire reimbursements 11,808 (Fire); 67,877 (Ambulance, detail[24]); CRA reimbursement 148,336 (Community Development, detail[69])
issues.issue: The extractor rules put rural fire contracts under charges for services/fees, and the user rule sends reimbursements to reimbursements/refunds. Intergovernmental can be defended (payments from the rural fire district or the CRA component unit), but it is a judgment call.
